summary.headline: Astrological Interrogations and Omens
summary.text: Astrological interrogations and weather omens, with entries on usefulness, danger, quadrants from Paulus Alexandrinus, glory, outcomes, fortune from slaves, royal dignity and authority, disturbances, travel and migration, illness, hidden treasure, civil war, success, marriage, reconciliation, and runaways, cross-referenced to Venetian codices.
